Unique filter-replicate code (LIRS_dd_mm_yy_replicate) that prefixes the fastq names; group the six replicates per date to fill biological_rep_relation.

Filter pore size; strip the text so '0.2 micron' becomes 0.2 (unit µm).

Name of the person who filtered the samples (constant: Joseph DiBattista); FAIRe has no processor field, so use it for project-level recordedBy (samp_mat_process does not fit because it describes the process).

Constant 'Australia' supplies the INSDC country part of geo_loc_name; combine with Reef Location and Sampling Location, e.g. 'Australia: Queensland, Great Barrier Reef, Lizard Island, Big Vicky's Reef'.
Site locality (Lizard Island, Big Vicky's Reef) that forms the locality part of geo_loc_name.
Broader region (Great Barrier Reef) that forms the region part of geo_loc_name.
Reef exposure class (constant 'Semi-Exposed'); no FAIRe term, so keep as a user-defined field.

Convert d-Mon-yy to ISO 8601 (12-Feb-19 becomes 2019-02-12); no time recorded, though methods give 10:00 to 16:00 AEST (+10:00).
Moon phase and per cent illumination tested as an explanatory variable; no FAIRe term, so keep as a user-defined field and list it in study_factor.

Days the water was held at -20 °C before thawing and filtering; convert to ISO 8601 (316 becomes P316D, 0 becomes P0D) and set samp_store_temp to -20, except February samples, which were kept on ice and filtered at once.
